_analysis_notes.frontend_scope_note: The current frontend is an Angular application for single candidate self-checking against one job description. The required frontend direction is a recruiter-facing screening interface where an employer uploads one job requirement and multiple CVs, then reviews ranked results and summary statistics.
_analysis_notes.current_frontend_note: As of 2026-04-13, the frontend has been significantly upgraded. It is now a recruiter-facing Angular app with batch CV upload, environment-based API configuration, typed response models, a ranked results dashboard, and PrimeNG throughout. Remaining gaps are minor: no CSV/print export, template-driven form instead of reactive, and no in-flight upload progress indicator.
important_gaps: No CSV export, print view, or structured report download exists.
The analyze form uses template-driven binding, not a reactive FormGroup.
No per-file upload progress bar or streaming feedback while the batch request is in flight.
The recruiter form has no optional fields for department, location, or employment type.
Empty-state handling exists inside the table emptymessage slot but there is no dedicated no-candidates page or route guard fallback with guidance copy.

status_legend.done: Implemented in the frontend and usable as-is
status_legend.partially done: Some frontend implementation exists, but it is incomplete, misaligned with the required flow, or limited to the current single-candidate experience
status_legend.not done: Required frontend capability does not exist yet

features.name: Angular application bootstrap
features.comment: The application is already bootstrapped with standalone Angular components and router configuration.

features.name: Landing page route
features.comment: The root route already renders a landing page and the CTA navigates to the analysis screen.

features.name: Analysis page route
features.comment: A dedicated /analyze route already exists and is connected to the analysis component.

features.name: Recruiter-specific navigation flow
features.comment: The page flow is now recruiter-oriented: landing -> /analyze (batch form) -> /results (ranked dashboard). The /results route guards against direct access and redirects to /analyze if no state data is present.

features.name: Visual landing screen
features.comment: The landing page is implemented with branding, hero content, imagery, and a working CTA.

features.name: Employer-facing product messaging
features.comment: Landing copy now reads 'Screen candidates. Hire the best fit.' with the eyebrow 'AI-Powered Candidate Screening', clearly targeting recruiters.

features.name: Recruiter workflow explanation
features.comment: A 'How it works' section with three numbered steps explains the full recruiter workflow: paste job requirements, upload candidate CVs, review ranked results.

features.name: Job requirement text input
features.comment: The analysis form includes a textarea for job description input with a minimum 30-character validation guard.

features.name: Single CV upload
features.comment: File input is wired to onFileChange(); the upload-format mismatch is resolved — input is restricted to PDF only via accept='.pdf' and runtime name-check.

features.name: Multiple CV upload
features.comment: The file input has the multiple attribute. selectedFiles[] accumulates all chosen PDFs, each file is individually listed with a remove button, and the batch is sent as multipart form-data.

features.name: Structured recruiter fields
features.comment: Job title (optional) and job description (required) fields exist. No dedicated fields for department, location, employment type, or other optional recruiter metadata have been added.

features.name: Frontend file validation
features.comment: Files are filtered by .pdf extension at selection time; non-PDF files are rejected with a named toast warning. Empty-selection and missing job description are also guarded before submission.

features.name: Reactive recruiter form model
features.comment: The screen uses template-driven binding (ngModel) rather than Angular ReactiveFormsModule. Validation works, but the model is not a typed FormGroup, which limits testability and strict validation control.

features.name: Real backend integration
features.comment: The JobFitService uses HttpClient and posts real form-data requests to the backend.

features.name: Single-candidate API contract usage
features.comment: The analyze() method is retained for backward compatibility. The component now exclusively uses screen() for the recruiter flow.

features.name: Batch screening API integration
features.comment: The screen() method appends all selected files under the 'resumes' key and posts to /screen. The response is typed as ScreeningResponse and the router.navigate state carries the full result to /results.

features.name: Environment-based API configuration
features.comment: The API base URL is read from environment.apiBase (src/environments/environment.ts) and injected into the service via private apiBase = environment.apiBase. Hardcoded URLs have been removed from the service.

features.name: Typed recruiter response models
features.comment: Full TypeScript interfaces are defined in job-fit.service.ts: SingleFitResponse, CandidateResult, FileError, ScreeningSummary, and ScreeningResponse. All fields match the backend /screen endpoint shape.

features.name: Single result badge display
features.comment: The results component maps labels to PrimeNG p-tag severity values (success/warn/danger) and renders them per candidate row.

features.name: Similarity score display
features.comment: Each candidate row shows a p-progressBar capped at scorePercent() and a numeric score formatted to two decimal places.

features.name: Ranked candidate list
features.comment: A PrimeNG p-table renders all candidates ordered by rank with rank badge (gold/silver/bronze for top 3), filename, score bar, fit label, and status pill.

features.name: Summary statistics cards
features.comment: Four stat cards display total CVs, shortlisted (good fit count + %), under review (potential fit count + %), and rejected (no fit count + %) with gradient color coding.

features.name: Employer-facing report layout
features.comment: Results page is a dashboard-style layout with a heading row (job title + navigation actions), summary stat grid, optional error section, and ranked candidate table.

features.name: Export-ready result presentation
features.comment: The frontend has no CSV export, print view, or report-friendly presentation for screening outcomes. This remains unimplemented.

features.name: Loading state during analysis
features.comment: The submit button switches label to 'Screening...' with a spinning icon and becomes disabled while isScreening is true.

features.name: Toast-based error feedback
features.comment: Toast messages cover missing file selection, missing or too-short job description, non-PDF file rejection, and API errors with the backend detail message included.

features.name: Reset workflow
features.comment: 'Screen Again' on the results page navigates back to /analyze. 'Back to Home' returns to the landing page. Both actions reset the view state.

features.name: Batch progress and per-file feedback
features.comment: Per-file errors returned by the backend are rendered on the results page as PrimeNG warn messages. However, there is no in-flight progress bar or partial update while the batch request is being processed.

features.name: Empty-state guidance for recruiter results
features.comment: The p-table emptymessage template shows 'No candidates were successfully processed.' There is no dedicated empty-state screen, illustration, or recruiter guidance copy for the zero-results scenario.

features.name: Responsive baseline layout
features.comment: Global styles include responsive breakpoints. The stats grid collapses from 4 to 2 to 1 column based on viewport width. The analyze form and landing hero are also responsive.

features.name: Component-specific styling structure
features.comment: analyze.component.scss and results.component.scss contain component-specific rules. Some foundational layout rules (container, header, card, form-group) remain in the global styles.scss.

features.name: Recruiter dashboard visual system
features.comment: The results page has a purpose-built recruiter dashboard with gradient stat cards, ranked table with rank badges, score progress bars, status pills, and structured section titles.

features.name: PrimeNG-based UI layer
features.comment: PrimeNG is used throughout: p-button, p-toast, p-table, p-tag, p-progressBar, p-message on the analyze and results components. Native HTML inputs are minimal and intentional (file input).

features.name: Consistent employer terminology across screens
features.comment: All labels, CTAs, and messaging use recruiter language: 'Screen CVs', 'Job Description', 'Upload CVs', 'Shortlisted', 'Under Review', 'Rejected', 'Screen Again'.
